About Nimbarkji Export

A family business that still checks every batch by hand.

Nimbarkji Export is a Jaipur-based family spice business operating under the Reals&Fresh brand. We source from trusted growers, grade to consistent standards, and pack under FSSAI-licensed conditions.

We have been in the industry for 10+ years and have remained consistent throughout our journey. We source all our spices and salts from across the country — and from international origins when specific requirements demand it.
